description: NaCo₂As₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.98 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two CoO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.26 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two CoO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.19 Å. There are three inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five CoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-62°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.80 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five CoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-64°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.82 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two CoO₆ octahedra and corners with two AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-60°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.78 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Co and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Co and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Co and one As atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Co, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two As atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Co, and one As atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, and one As atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Co, and one As atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Co, and one As atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two As atoms.
